summary: Feed s080_single is degraded: SIEM 1 Gbps port severely overloaded by 4.33 Gbps microbursts (433% of capacity, 2 intervals). All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLAN, one-way, oversize, drops, truncation, tunnels) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering aggregate/bursty traffic directly to a single 1 Gbps SIEM port without load balancing or rate control. Peak measured 4.33 Gbps in 1 ms bursts exceeds port capacity by 433% (threshold 0.8 Gbps), causing 2 overloaded intervals.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM ingress buffers overflow and tail-drop packets indiscriminately during bursts. Results in missed events/logs, incomplete correlation, and reduced detection coverage despite SIEM not requiring both directions or full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 5x1G or 10G load-balanced SIEM ingress ports/cluster using 5-tuple hashing so no single port exceeds ~80% utilization, eliminating burst drops and preserving complete event delivery.
